newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Peters pledges prudent NZ Budget Policy Statement.
newsitem.headline: Peters pledges prudent NZ Budget Policy Statement.

text.p: New Zealand Treasurer Winston Peters on Thursday pledged to be responsible and prudent but to show a "social conscience" in next week's Budget Policy Statement.
"It is the very best I think this country can afford. It has regard to the economic fundamentals that this country needs," Peters told parliament.

"I'm certain when people see the details they will know there is a responsible, prudent government in this country that has a sense of social conscience, that has a sense of humanity, that has addressed the issues reponsibly for the New Zealand people," he said.
The BPS, the first major set-piece that Peters will have presented since becoming Treasurer in December, is due for release at 2 p.m. (0100 GMT) on Tuesday.
